description: This file defines the PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule', which represents a modular component for handling HTML or XHTML elements, tags, attributes, and transformations within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains properties for module metadata, element definitions, and methods for managing elements, content models, attributes, and transformations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule
classes.description: Represents a modular component of HTML elements, attributes, and transformations within the HTMLPurifier library, providing mechanisms for managing element definitions, content models, attribute collections, and transformation processes.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns a child definition subclass based on the element's content_model and content_model_type; default implementation returns false.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the module with specified content type, content model, attributes, and content set, creating a corresponding element definition object.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates a new, non-standalone, blank element definition if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: addElementToContentSet
methods.description: Registers an element to a specified content set type.

methods.name: parseContents
methods.description: Parses a string representing an element's content model into a type and content model definition.

methods.name: mergeInAttrIncludes
methods.description: Merges attribute collection includes into an attribute array.

methods.name: makeLookup
methods.description: Generates a lookup table (associative array with true values) from a list of values.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Performs lazy loading or configuration setup; default implementation is empty.
